relations.subject: Otto Max Helmuth von Glasenapp
relations.evidence: On 6 May 1946, he was given the chair of Indology and Comparative Religious Studies of his former teacher Richard Karl von Garbe in Tübingen

relations.subject: Paul Thieme
relations.evidence: He retired in 1959, but continued to lecture until his death in 1963, primarily in the field of Religious studies, while the field of Indology was taken over by his successor Paul Thieme.
